description: Track E — Admin: terminology (Community/Slot level+status/User), user verification (unit_verified grant state + verify action + createPass gate), sites+users bulk import/export, admin menu pruning, and localization reduced to es-MX+en with docs reconciliation. Requirements AC-5.1..5.4; design section 5 + migration/data-model plan. Appends the verification columns + the user_memberships/claim_invites/accept_invite changes to migration 018, and completes the ctx.unitVerified/me.unitVerified wiring that FEAT-003's pending-verification banner consumes. Run last; it finalizes the migration and reconciles docs/PERSONAS.md + ARCHITECTURE.md.
steps: Migration 018_epd_feedback.sql (append): membership.unit_verified boolean not null default false with resident-only backfill `update membership set unit_verified = true where 'resident' = any(roles)`; membership_invite.unit_verified boolean not null default false. Drop + recreate user_memberships(uuid) adding unit_verified to the returns table and the select (base body from migration 009), then `revoke execute ... from public; grant execute ... to openpark_app`. `create or replace` claim_invites (current body migration 012) and accept_invite (current body migration 016), each adding unit_verified to the insert column list and the select from membership_invite; preserve every other clause verbatim (superadmin update, delete from membership_invite, on conflict do nothing, revoke/grant).
API — Ctx (apps/api/src/http.ts): add `unitVerified: boolean`. server.ts: set it from the user_memberships row in the member branch; false in the API-key and super-admin branches.

API — addPerson (services/people.ts): add a `unitVerified: boolean` parameter written into BOTH inserts (insert into membership (..., unit_verified) and insert into membership_invite (..., unit_verified)). Callers: POST /v1/users and POST /v1/platform/tenants/:slug/members pass unitVerified: true (staff vouches); the users bulk importer (below) passes false by default (optional per-import verifyUnits flag can pass true).

API — gate createPass (services/passes.ts) exactly once: after unitFor resolves the unit, if the caller is a resident on their own unit (NOT can(ctx,'pass.admin')) and ctx.unitVerified === false, throw HttpError(403,'unit_unverified'). Staff with pass.admin bypass. Do NOT gate GET /v1/passes or GET /v1/passes/active (reads stay open so the pending-verification banner can load pass/policy). Pin in apps/api/test/passes.test.ts (unverified resident rejected; verified accepted; staff bypass; /v1/passes/active returns { pass:null, policy } for an unverified resident).

API — PATCH /v1/users/:id/verify (routes/people.ts, perm 'users.edit', idempotent): set unit_verified = true for that member's resident grant and write an audit_event; 404/409 not_resident if not a resident. GET /v1/me (routes/auth.ts): add unitVerified: boolean from ctx.unitVerified.

Web — People.tsx: show an unverified badge and a 'Verify unit access' action per member; list unverified residents distinctly. apps/web/src/app-context.ts: add unitVerified to the me type so FEAT-003's banner reads a real field.

API — terminology: rename surfaced Property -> Community in docs/DOMAIN.md and UI/i18n labels (nav.*, screen headings) WITHOUT renaming the tenant table. Add community-level settings.address / settings.notes via the existing PATCH /v1/tenant (extend its Zod body + the settings jsonb merge) and surface a Community settings panel. Keep Site as the facility beneath a community.

API — slot level/status: add `z.level as level` to the EXISTING GET /v1/slots projection (routes/slots.ts; the zone z join is already present — purely additive). Web: render a Level column on Slots.tsx and Parking.tsx from row.level. Slots admin gains a Status selector (operational=available / out_of_service / reserved) mapping to the existing PATCH /v1/slots/:code enum; an occupied slot's status renders as a non-editable label (occupied is never a selectable option).

API — bulk sites: add GET /v1/sites/export + POST /v1/sites/import[?mode=&dryRun=] + .../apply + .../rollback (routes/slots.ts + a new sites import service) following the inventory/units pipeline (validate JSON of sites[{code,name,timezone,address?,notes?}] -> diff -> preview -> apply in one tx with audit_event + rollback snapshot; conflict on retiring a site with cars inside blocks apply).

API — bulk users: add GET /v1/users/export + POST /v1/users/import + apply/rollback (routes/people.ts + a new users import service). Each row calls the unitVerified-extended addPerson with direct:false (invite path — NO plaintext OTP in any payload) and unitVerified:false by default (optional verifyUnits:true marks a trusted import verified). Export/diff carry NO secrets (only email, name, roles, unit, unit_verified). Row-level errors -> line-level 400; conflicts block apply; apply is one atomic tx; one bad row becomes a per-row skipped/conflict entry in the diff. (Backlog the non-default seedPasswords OTP flag; do not build it.)

Web — present one 'Bulk import/export' admin screen with entity tabs (Communities, Slots, Units, Users) by refactoring Inventory.tsx/Units import UI into a shared <ImportExport entity=> component reusing validate/preview/apply/rollback.

Web — menu pruning + localization: remove the `locale` route from App.tsx and the `locale` entry from menu.ts; delete/unroute LocaleSettings in Settings.tsx (keep AiSettings). Net admin menu: Communities & parking, Units, Users, Bulk import/export, Advanced group (Rates, Integrations, AI). Add `export const SELECTABLE_LOCALES = ['es-MX','en'] as const` in i18n.tsx; the footer switcher (AppMenu.tsx) maps only SELECTABLE_LOCALES (leave the full LOCALES array untouched; en-XA stays dev-only). Add a surface-fold in the i18n provider: active = SELECTABLE_LOCALES.includes(resolved) ? resolved : foldToSurface(resolved) where foldToSurface maps es-* -> es-MX else -> en; keep resolveLocale returning es-ES unchanged so the parity test still passes. Do NOT delete any catalog file.

Tests + docs: update apps/web/test/menu.test.ts (ADMIN_ITEMS without 'locale', Advanced grouping) without weakening coverage; add a rendered test asserting the language switcher lists only es-MX + en; keep the locale parity + Arabic RTL tests green. Reconcile ARCHITECTURE.md Localization + Screens table (surface es-MX default + English; pt-BR/fr/de/ar/es-ES dormant for ICU/RTL coverage, not user-selectable; remove 'Localization settings' from Admin screens; keep the Arabic RTL note) and update docs/PERSONAS.md + docs/DOMAIN.md terminology/locale claims to match. Add all new UI strings (Community labels, Notes field, slot level/status, bulk tabs, verify action/badge) to ALL seven web catalogs; add any new notify strings to EVERY catalog in apps/api/src/notify/messages.ts.
acceptance_criteria: membership.unit_verified + membership_invite.unit_verified exist with the resident-only backfill; user_memberships/claim_invites/accept_invite carry unit_verified; ctx.unitVerified and me.unitVerified are populated.

Only verified residents can issue passes: createPass rejects an unverified resident caller with 403 unit_unverified while staff (pass.admin) bypass and reads stay ungated; PATCH /v1/users/:id/verify flips the flag and audits; API tests pin all of this.

Community terminology is surfaced (Property renamed in docs + UI/i18n without renaming the tenant table) with optional community address + Notes; Slots surface level (from zone) and status (operational/out_of_service/reserved; occupied read-only) and the gate auto-assign excludes reserved/out_of_service.

Bulk import/export exists for Communities/Sites and Users (plus the existing Slots/Units) following validate->diff->preview->apply->rollback; users export/diff carry no secrets and created rows take the invite path (no plaintext OTP).

The Localization admin screen and route are removed; the language switcher lists exactly es-MX + en; all catalogs stay on disk and the locale-parity + Arabic RTL tests stay green; a stored es-ES preference folds to es-MX without error.
menu.test.ts (updated), the switcher render test, and the full verification gate pass; ARCHITECTURE.md/docs reconciled to the reduced locale set and new terminology.
findings:
DONE. Full gate green: core build, typecheck (all 7 projects), pnpm test (api 126, web 125+1 skip, core 36, sdk 6, marketing 9), web check:css (logical-only). Postgres already running on :54329; API tests build a FRESH DB per run (test/global-setup.ts) and run every migration from scratch, so the appended 018 is proven to apply cleanly there (the persistent dev DB was left untouched — its 018 row predates this append; re-run pnpm migrate would skip it, which is fine since the gate uses the fresh test DB).

MIGRATION 018 (apps/api/migrations/018_epd_feedback.sql) — APPENDED below FEAT-003/004's columns (did NOT create a new file, did NOT reorder): membership.unit_verified boolean not null default false + resident-only backfill `update membership set unit_verified = true where 'resident' = any(roles)`; membership_invite.unit_verified boolean not null default false; drop+recreate user_memberships(uuid) adding unit_verified to the returns table + select (from 009 shape) + revoke public/grant openpark_app; `create or replace` claim_invites (012 body) and accept_invite (016 body) each with unit_verified carried into the insert column list + the select, every other clause verbatim; and widened inventory_import.kind check to include 'sites' and 'users' (drop+re-add the check constraint) for the two new bulk pipelines.

VERIFICATION WIRING (the FEAT-003 banner contract, now FINALIZED):
- Ctx (apps/api/src/http.ts): added `unitVerified: boolean`. server.ts sets it from m.unit_verified in the member branch, false in the API-key and super-admin branches (all three Ctx constructors updated).
- GET /v1/me (routes/auth.ts): returns `unitVerified: ctx.unitVerified`. Also added community `address`/`notes` to the tenant projection (settings->>'address'/'notes'). Resident.tsx already reads me.unitVerified defensively; app-context.tsx Me.unitVerified stays OPTIONAL (left as `unitVerified?: boolean`) because the shell-collapse/language-switcher test fixtures build Me without it — making it required would not break typecheck (web tsconfig excludes test/) but keeping it optional avoids churn and the field is now always present from the API. address/notes added to Me.tenant (required string|null).
- createPass GATE (services/passes.ts) — the ONE enforcement point, right after unitFor: `if (!can(ctx,'pass.admin') && ctx.unitVerified === false) throw HttpError(403,'unit_unverified')`. Staff with pass.admin bypass; GET /v1/passes and /v1/passes/active stay ungated (reads). Pinned in passes.test.ts: unverified rejected 403 unit_unverified; verified accepted; staff bypass; /v1/passes/active returns {pass:null, policy} for an unverified resident; me.unitVerified reflects the flag.
- PATCH /v1/users/:id/verify (routes/people.ts, perm users.edit, idempotent): sets unit_verified=true for the member's resident grant + audit_event; 404 member_not_found / 409 not_resident. GET /v1/users now also returns m.unit_verified so People.tsx can show the badge.

addPerson (services/people.ts): added `unitVerified?: boolean` written into BOTH inserts. POST /v1/users and POST /v1/platform/tenants/:slug/members pass unitVerified:true (staff vouches). units-import residents also pass true (admin-placed). ALSO added `inviteOnly?: boolean`: when set, an unknown email ALWAYS becomes a membership_invite (never a local account + OTP) — the users bulk importer uses this so NO plaintext secret ever enters any export/diff/apply payload even under local auth (the shipped `direct:false` alone does NOT force the invite path under local auth, which is why inviteOnly was added; POST /v1/users behaviour is unchanged).

TERMINOLOGY/SLOT (surfaced, no table rename): GET /v1/slots projection gained `z.level as level` (zone join already present). Slots.tsx renders Level in the grid + a Status selector (operational=available / out_of_service / reserved; occupied shown read-only, never selectable). Parking.tsx slot table gained a Level column. suggestSlot already excludes reserved/out_of_service (filters status='available') — confirmed, unchanged. PATCH /v1/tenant (routes/auth.ts) gained optional address/notes merged into settings jsonb; a Community settings panel (CommunitySettings in Parking.tsx) edits them. nav.property label -> 'Community', nav.parking/parking.* -> 'Communities & parking'.

BULK IMPORT/EXPORT: new services/sites.ts (SitesDoc, diff/preview/apply/export; replace conflict blocks retiring a site with cars inside; rollback restores the snapshot via mode='replace') + routes in routes/slots.ts: GET /v1/sites/export, POST /v1/sites/import[?mode=&dryRun=], .../apply, .../rollback. New services/usersimport.ts (UsersDoc, diff/preview/apply/export; invite path only via inviteOnly; verifyUnits flag marks a whole trusted import verified, else per-row unitVerified, else false; resident with no existing unit is a line-level error; export/diff carry ONLY email/name/roles/unit/unitVerified — no secrets) + routes in routes/people.ts: GET /v1/users/export, POST /v1/users/import[?dryRun=], .../apply, .../rollback (rollback withdraws the pending invitations the import created). Both pipelines write audit_event; apply is one tx. Web: new screens/Bulk.tsx — ONE Bulk import/export screen with entity tabs (Communities/Slots/Units/Users) sharing an <ImportExport> panel (validate->preview->apply->rollback), reusing the shipped inventory/units endpoints for the Slots/Units tabs. Routed at /t/:slug/bulk; the old /inventory + Units import UIs remain reachable but the new screen is the consolidated surface.

MENU + LOCALE: menu.ts admin group = [parking, units, users, bulkio, rates, integrations, ai] (+organisations for super admin); the `locale` entry is REMOVED and rates/integrations/ai are the Advanced tail. App.tsx: removed the /locale route + LocaleSettings import, added /bulk. Settings.tsx: LocaleSettings function DELETED (AiSettings kept). i18n.tsx: added `SELECTABLE_LOCALES=['es-MX','en']` + `foldToSurface` (es-* -> es-MX else -> en); the provider computes active = SELECTABLE_LOCALES.includes(resolved) ? resolved : foldToSurface(resolved); resolveLocale UNCHANGED (still returns es-ES etc. so the parity test passes). AppMenu.tsx footer switcher maps ONLY SELECTABLE_LOCALES (en-XA dropped from the switcher; the full LOCALES array untouched; no catalog deleted).

TESTS: passes.test.ts +5 cases (verification gate: unverified rejected/verified accepted/staff bypass/active ungated/verify route 404+409). New apps/api/test/bulk-import.test.ts (7 cases: sites export-no-secrets + import+apply, dry-run refused + rollback restores, replace-with-cars-inside conflict blocks; users invite-path-no-secret, unverified default vs verifyUnits:true, resident-no-unit line error, export carries no secrets). New apps/web/test/language-switcher.test.tsx (switcher lists exactly es-MX+en; stored es-ES folds to es-MX). menu.test.ts updated (ADMIN_ITEMS reshaped, locale-removed + bulkio-present + Advanced-tail assertions) without weakening coverage; locale parity + Arabic RTL tests unchanged and green.

LOCALES: new UI strings (nav.bulkio, bulk.title/communities/slots/units/users, users.verified/unverified/verifyUnit, slots.operational/occupiedReadonly, community.settings/edit/address/notes, err.unit_unverified/not_resident) + changed labels (nav.parking, nav.property, parking.title/intro) added to ALL SEVEN catalogs (en, es-MX, es-ES, pt-BR, fr, de, ar) with identical keys (549 each); en-XA untouched (build-generated). NO new notify strings were needed (no new notification kinds), so apps/api/src/notify/messages.ts is unchanged.

PRESERVED: overstay policy (announced charge, fmt.money from tenant.settings.passPolicy.overstayCharge, never a literal; MXN seed 500000 untouched) and the HMAC OPP2 pass token (server re-reads the pass, never trusts client fields; passToken/parsePassToken unchanged).

DOCS: ARCHITECTURE.md Localization section rewritten (surfaces es-MX default + English; es-ES/pt-BR/fr/de/ar dormant for ICU/RTL, Arabic retained as RTL proof; foldToSurface note), Admin role line reworded (Community terminology, bulk, verify residents, no locale screen), Screens table swaps 'Localization settings' for 'Bulk import/export'. docs/DOMAIN.md: Property term surfaced as Community (tenant table unchanged, address/notes noted), Slot level+status + assignable-only-when-available, Person unit_verified gate, screen-connections + a new Locales section. docs/PERSONAS.md already matched (FEAT-001) — left as-is.

AUTONOMY DECISIONS (per the standing lowest-risk/most-reversible rule): (1) Added addPerson `inviteOnly` instead of changing shipped `direct:false` semantics, so the users importer never emits an OTP while POST /v1/users keeps returning one — reversible, no behaviour change to existing callers. (2) Kept the standalone /inventory and /units import UIs reachable alongside the new consolidated /bulk screen (lowest-risk; no screen deleted). (3) The multi-unit-per-community model stays single-unit-per-membership (design D3 backlog); not touched here. (4) sites rollback uses mode='replace' against the pre-import snapshot so an import-added site is retired on rollback.
